description: This file defines internal API function prototypes for an HTTP MboFile object, including functions for handling transfer sizes, appending body content, clearing, copying, and saving body data, and output processing.

methods.name: HttpMboFileGetTransferSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the transfer buffer or content.

methods.name: HttpMboFileAppendBodyBdo
methods.description: Appends a Body Data Object (Bdo) to the current body.

methods.name: HttpMboFileAppendBodyFile
methods.description: Appends the content of a specified file to the body within a given byte range.

methods.name: HttpMboFileCopyBodyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from a buffer into the body.

methods.name: HttpMboFileCopyBodyInto
methods.description: Copies the body content into a buffer.

methods.name: HttpMboFileSaveAsBody
methods.description: Saves data from a buffer into the body.

methods.name: HttpMboFileSaveBodyAsFile
methods.description: Saves the current body content into a file, with optional flush.

methods.name: HttpMboFileSaveFormAsFile
methods.description: Saves form parameters as a file, with optional flush.

methods.name: HttpMboFileOutput
methods.description: Serializes and outputs the current object state.
